verdict.rationale: Radar's docs say it provides real-time fraud protection and screens every payment attempt. The testing docs show charges carry a Radar-assigned risk level (e.g. `highest`), so a risk assessment is attached to transactions. Nothing documents a standalone, synchronous scoring API that returns an ML score to the developer before authorization completes. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for requesting a risk score pre-authorization, evidence of synchronous return timing, numeric score detail beyond risk-level labels, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a machine-learning risk score for a transaction in real time — synchronously, before authorization completes — through a documented API
